meta.name: (URL query parameter, not a meta tag)
meta.description: Activate the print-preview view by adding `?print=preview` to any URL (`?print=normal` exits). Preview mode persists in sessionStorage so internal links keep the styling. Useful for QAing the print stylesheet without spawning the browser print dialog.

data.description: Placeholder element that becomes a 'Print page' button.
Empty element auto-filled with today's date when the print stylesheet loads. Useful for stamping printed pages.
